description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states, as well as classes for text parsing ('TextParser') and path parsing ('PathParser') within the 'WPEFramework::Core' namespace. It includes external headers related to enumeration, key-value pairs, numbers, optionals, portability, and ranges, indicating its role in a larger parsing framework.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with various states, supporting operations like collecting words, lines, handling escape sequences, and pass-through functionality.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, reading text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges, with utility functions for skipping and finding text.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a TextFragment, extracting text based on delimiters.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions in the text.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates if the current text matches a comparison string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of a specified type from the text.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text based on a delimiter.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a TextFragment into its components (Drive, Path, FileName, etc.).
